title: Tendo
features: Customer onboarding with role choice (book a service or offer services) and phone sign-up
Browse home service categories (cleaning, plumbing, electrical, handyman, moving, beauty) and search
Provider list with rating, price per hour, distance and availability, filter chips
Provider profile with verified badge, services and prices, portfolio photos and reviews
Book a service: pick service package, date, time slot, address and notes
Checkout with price breakdown, service fee, saved card (payment simulated)
Live booking status timeline: requested, accepted, on the way, in progress, completed (simulated)
In-app chat between customer and provider (mock thread, quick replies)
Bookings list with upcoming and past tabs, plus empty state
Rate and review the provider after the job
Profile with addresses, payment methods, notifications and a switch to provider mode
Provider mode dashboard: incoming job requests to accept or decline, today's earnings (simulated other side)

bottomTabBar.note: Flat white bar, 1px top border, no gradient. Active tab: icon + label in accentFill with a small accentTint pill behind the icon; inactive: text.secondary.

sharedComponents.statusBar: Header on tab screens: screen title (or greeting) on the left in display style, round avatar or bell icon button on the right.
sharedComponents.controls: Primary button: pill, 56px tall, accentFill with white label (pressed darker, disabled 40% opacity). Secondary button: pill, white with 1.5px borderStrong border, ink label. Text input: 12px radius, 52px, white, borderStrong border, focus = 2px accentFill ring, error = danger border + 13px helper. Card: white, 20px radius, soft shadow. Chip: pill, 32px, accentTint fill with accentFill text, 13px; selected chip = accentFill fill with white text. Rating: small star icon in warning amber + number.

type.minSize: 12px (13px chips and tags, 14px safety or legal text)
type.scaleRule: Use only the 5 declared sizes (display, title, body, label, caption).

designSystem.a11y: white labels on accentFill only; text on gradients >= 4.5:1; tap targets >= 44pt

results.pair: accentFill as link text on background
warning text on its tint and on surface
success text on its tint and on surface
support as chart line / icon on surface (non-text 3:1)
